page.overview:
What is Bay of Balar?

The Bay of Balar was an ocean inlet of Belegaer located south of Beleriand, fed by the River Sirion.

It was presumably created in the cataclysms that accompanied the struggles of the Valar with Morgoth long before recorded history.

The Isle of Balar was a large island in the bay.

The bay's name Balar refers to the Valar (and Maiar), especially Ossë, who was associated with continental shelf areas. In Telerin the name Valar was Balai, and in Sindarin the form it took was eventually Bala.
